description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mudduwa, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620270
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed descriptions of land parcels, their locations, cadastral references, and ownership details (including transfers to "The State" and "Road Development Authority"). The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
